settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Appearance, security and the current session of this account. Platform status is reserved to administrators.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Theme and language apply instantly and are remembered in this browser.
appearance.themeHint: System follows the theme of your operating system.
appearance.languageHint: The interface re-translates immediately, no reload needed.
appearance.applied: Each choice is applied and saved as you pick it.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Change the password of this account.
security.policy: At least 8 characters (200 maximum), with at least one letter and one digit.
security.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
security.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.
security.revokeNote: Changing the password revokes every active session of this account on the server: you are signed out of all your devices and must sign in again.

session.title: Session
session.subtitle: The account this browser is signed in with.

platform.title: Fuseki endpoint and health
platform.subtitle: Read-only view of the triple store, served by the health probe and the status endpoint.
platform.statusFailed: The platform status could not be loaded.
platform.statsFailed: The ontology statistics could not be loaded.
platform.storeHint: The probe answers 503 when the store is down; the report is shown here as data, never as a toast.
